whyItMatters: an IPMI password passed with -P is captured by the shell history, the CI log and the image layer, so deleting the line later does not undo the exposure.
actions: Rotate the credential at the target system.
Pass the value through the environment or a protected credential file instead of the command line.
Scrub the value from logs, images and history.
verification: The old credential is rejected and no invocation of this shape carries a literal any more.
